info.title: D.O.X Workspace API
info.description: Single source of truth for D.O.X Workspace, Hermes and Traycer. Web clients use Secure HttpOnly cookies; desktop clients request bearer tokens with client=desktop. Every domain endpoint enforces current database roles and relationship visibility. Clients have view-only transaction/document/thread access. Invalid authentication: 401; forbidden role: 403; invisible object: 404; validation: 422; conflict: 409; limits: 429. AI and events use SSE.

200.description: SSE events: ready, change {timestamp}, expired. Cookie or bearer authentication. Reconnect after token refresh.

schema.title: Response Logs Api Ai Logs Get

200.description: SSE JSON data events: {type:delta,text:string}, {type:done,log_id:string,sources:[{id,title,path}]}, {type:error,message:string}. Request includes template, optional transaction_id (required for transaction templates), optional prompt (required for knowledge). Knowledge answers use only vault items the user is permitted to access. No raw credentials accepted.

200.description: dox-vault command-line tool: syncs an Obsidian folder or Microsoft 365 (CLI for Microsoft 365) files into the knowledge vault using owner desktop tokens.
Owner-only handoff bundle: backend, frontend source, docs, CLI, tests and merge guides for folding the workspace into thedoxs.com.
